partially_covered.missing: Still only organizationName and addressLine are modeled; no extensible structure for additional organization attributes such as tax ID, contact, or organization metadata. No OrganizationDetail or similar class.
No explicit modeling of file format constraints or validation requirements. No SHACL shapes, OWL restrictions, or other mechanisms to define mandatory fields or structure.

cq_coverage.details: All CQs except CQ5 and CQ13 are directly answerable using existing classes and properties. CQ5 lacks extensibility for richer organization metadata, and CQ13 does not model file format validity constraints.

strengths: Good use of reification for n-ary relations
weaknesses: No use of GCAs or equivalence axioms

likely_oops_pitfalls: P4: Missing domain or range in some properties (if extended)
P7: Shallow hierarchy, potential for class explosion if extended

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Model file format validity requirements explicitly, e.g., via SHACL or additional OWL restrictions, to address CQ13.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Enables automated validation of EDIFACT file structure and required fields.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Extend Organization with optional properties (e.g., tax ID, contact info) and/or an OrganizationDetail class to fully answer CQ5.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Allows richer queries about organization metadata.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Introduce General Class Axioms (GCAs) to define key concepts (e.g., BuyerOrganization ≡ Organization and (isBuyerOf some Invoice)).
Deepen class hierarchy by introducing subclasses (e.g., Company, Supplier, Customer under Organization; Product, Service under Item).

improvement_tracking.notes: No substantive changes detected since iteration 1. All improvement suggestions remain unaddressed. No new issues were introduced, but there is no evidence of progress in quality or coverage.

summary: The ontology maintains strong coverage for most CQs and adheres to OWL 2 best practices, with correct use of reification and annotation. However, none of the previously identified improvement suggestions have been implemented. File format constraints and richer organization/item metadata remain unmodeled, and the class hierarchy is still shallow. No regressions, but also no progress in quality or coverage.
